# S. Thangapazham College of Engineering and Technology (STCET)

> Official website of S. Thangapazham College of Engineering and Technology, an engineering college in Vasudevanallur, Tenkasi District, Tamil Nadu, India.

Use the following pages as the primary sources for information about the college, its programmes, admissions, campus, and student services.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://stcet.in/): College overview and campus highlights.
- [About](https://stcet.in/about): About the institution.
- [Admissions](https://stcet.in/admissions): Admission information and eligibility.
- [Courses](https://stcet.in/courses): Engineering programmes.
- [Faculties](https://stcet.in/faculties): Faculty information.
- [Infrastructure](https://stcet.in/infrastructure): Campus facilities.
- [Placements](https://stcet.in/placements): Placement information.
- [Scholarships](https://stcet.in/scholarships): Scholarship information.
- [Events](https://stcet.in/events): College events.
- [Gallery](https://stcet.in/gallery): Campus and college photos.
- [Contact](https://stcet.in/contact): Contact information.
- [Enquire now](https://stcet.in/enquire-now): Admissions enquiry.
